content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Contrastive self-supervised learning frameworks for tabular sensor data modulate target similarity between anchor and candidate points by elapsed time, and encode observed/unobserved status as part of token embedding and time-gap information into feature representations.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08881","field":"abstract","quote":"target similarity between an anchor and a candidate positive is modulated by the elapsed time"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08885","field":"abstract","quote":"missiveness-aware feature tokeniser that encodes observed/unobserved status as part of the token embedding, a time-gap encoding that injects elapsed-time information"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Unsupervised learning methods for industrial SCADA and sensor data have been validated on multi-month production records from manufacturing facilities without requiring attack labels or supervised annotations, including six months of data from a food-processing line and eight months from a plastics extrusion facility.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08878","field":"abstract","quote":"six months of data from a food-processing line and eight months from a plastics extrusion facility"}]}]}
